project.name: Competitor Radar
project.purpose: Local-first competitor monitoring with a Next.js control plane, Fastify scraping worker, Inngest orchestration, and Supabase/Postgres persistence.

validation: Windows scheduled task Competition Radar Automation

facts: The worker remains request-driven for competitor scraping and additionally owns a whitelisted TorqueCore shipment monitor backed by shipment_tracking_runs.
Scheduled competitor work is created by Inngest cron every five minutes and fan-outs store and product events with per-store concurrency limits.
Regular Playwright fetching is headless and pooled; manual takeover sessions use a separate headed persistent context and retain per-domain storage state.
apps/desktop is the Electron tray supervisor for hidden web, worker, and Inngest processes with automatic restart.
Shipment tracking uses headed minimized/off-screen Chrome, runs sequentially, and never promotes browser evidence into canonical TorqueCore shipment fields.
service_heartbeats is populated by the web health check rather than an autonomous worker heartbeat loop.
Local Supabase is already running on ports 54321-54323; web, worker, and Inngest were stopped during the 2026-07-17 audit.
Server-only credentials must remain outside NEXT_PUBLIC variables and must never be returned by worker health or application logs.
The repository currently contains unrelated user changes in .claude/settings.local.json and supabase/.temp/cli-latest; preserve them.
